record.name: Slack
record.one_liner: A channel-based messaging platform for team collaboration and productivity.
record.access_note: Developers can sign up for a free developer account or workspace and register applications to obtain credentials.
record.api_note: Covers messaging, channels, users, reactions, search, and other collaboration features through the Web API.

evidence.quote: Slack apps use OAuth scopes to govern what they can access.
